why: CARD ADVANTAGE, ON TOP OF lands-v1 (this list carries its two fetches and the Swamp). deck-audit reads five draw copies against a target of ten. Skullclamp in: fifteen of the deck's infect bodies have one toughness, so every equip draws two, and it is the one activation docs/gotchas-bench.md shows Forge's AI actually uses (1.25 activations per cast, against 0.00 for Ashnod's Altar) -- the goldfish cannot read it and the record will. Read the Bones and Dark Confidant in as draw the goldfish CAN read. Out: Combat Celebrant and Staff of Compleation, the two cards the 55-card leave-one-out sweep ranked least needed among the non-interaction, both of whose real value is in an activation or an extra combat the model does not price; and Ogre Menial, a four-mana 3/3 the sweep found worth 0.001 of kill_by_8. Objective on the draw axis the goldfish sees; Skullclamp's share is Forge's to measure.
